parameters.jsCode: const required=['correlation_id','signal_type','title','description','detected_by'];for(const key of required){if(!$json[key])throw new Error(`${key} is required`);}const allowedSignals=new Set(['workflow_failure','verification_failure','user_feedback','stale_memory','uncategorized_information','repeated_manual_work','missing_capability_request','provider_api_change','policy_change','cost_or_performance']);const signal=allowedSignals.has($json.signal_type)?$json.signal_type:'missing_capability_request';const risk=['LOW','MEDIUM','HIGH','CRITICAL'].includes($json.risk_level)?$json.risk_level:'MEDIUM';const evidence=Array.isArray($json.evidence)?$json.evidence.slice(0,50):[];return [{json:{...$json,signal_type:signal,risk_level:risk,urgency:String($json.urgency||'NORMAL'),occurrence_count:Math.max(1,Number($json.occurrence_count||1)),affected_components:Array.isArray($json.affected_components)?$json.affected_components.slice(0,50):[],evidence,evidence_json:JSON.stringify(evidence),components_json:JSON.stringify(Array.isArray($json.affected_components)?$json.affected_components.slice(0,50):[])}}];

parameters.query: WITH selected_store AS (SELECT id FROM stores WHERE shop_domain = NULLIF($1,'') AND active = true), inserted AS (INSERT INTO improvement_cases (store_id, correlation_id, signal_type, title, description, status, risk_level, urgency, occurrence_count, affected_components, evidence, detected_by) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM selected_store), $2, $3, $4, $5, 'DETECTED', $6, $7, $8, $9::jsonb, $10::jsonb, $11) ON CONFLICT (correlation_id) DO UPDATE SET occurrence_count = improvement_cases.occurrence_count + EXCLUDED.occurrence_count, evidence = improvement_cases.evidence || EXCLUDED.evidence, updated_at = now() RETURNING id, status, risk_level) SELECT id AS improvement_case_id, status, risk_level FROM inserted;
